- The consistant runs of Simon Williamson & Leo Lyons until injury struck Leo. - The emerging talents of Adam Christie & Mike Nouch and not forgetting Mark Sinclair's first (of many we hope) Club Senior C.C. title.

Congratulations to Carl Lawton on his election as President of the Southern Road Walking Assoc. and to Gordon Biscoe who is this year's President of The South of The Thames CCA. Mike Nouch is back running better than ever and we learn that he was married in the summer.
Derek Clack and Mike Nouch continue to improve and young Andy North made a welcome return after a back injury which has put him out for the last year.
Following Mark Sinclair and John Gladwin are Bob Lettin(71), Leo Coy, Olly Foote, Laurie O'Hara, Mike Nouch,Eric Crutcher(70),Martin Lake,Simon Williamson(68),and Keith Sinclair(22).
Fine runs were recorded by Mike Nouch, Martin Lake and Eric Crutcher and Mike was considered by some to have been unlucky in not winning the handicap.
New member Len Best, who started with the Gorman pack and graduated to 18 milers, surprised more established runners but it was the ever improving Mike Nouch who took gold with Martin Lake third.

Belgrave B: M.Nouch 16.59; K.Francis 17.38; M.Lake 17.11; R.O'Hara 17.42; M.Bizio 16.56; C.Millbank 17.06. Fastest legs: K.Palmer (Highgate) 15.05; K.Steer (Ilford) 15.17; K.Doulton (Enfield) 15.21; O.Foote 15.24.
Rex Bale ran a very good race and was the first of our vets but there were also good performances by several of our non-vets: Mick Nouch (53:37), Trevor Williams (53:43) and Vic Butcher (59:05).
